accept.none: @{duel:user} no challenge is waiting for you. Start one with !duel <user> <amount>.
accept.notYou: @{duel:user} only the challenged party can answer this one.
accept.short: @{duel:user} you can't cover the stake right now.
accept.unknown: @{duel:user} I haven't seen you in this channel yet. Stick around to earn some {duel:points} first!
auto_won: The pot duel closed and @{duel:user} takes it all: {duel:amount} {duel:points}!
busy: @{duel:user} that duel is being settled right now, give it a second.
cancel.denied: @{duel:user} only the opener or a moderator can cancel a duel.
challenge.pending: @{duel:user} a head-to-head challenge is pending. Wait for it to settle.
challenge.sent: @{duel:user} challenges @{duel:target} for {duel:stake} {duel:points}! @{duel:target}, type !duel accept within {duel:secs}s. Winner takes {duel:pot}!
join.already: @{duel:user} you're already in this duel ({duel:count} entered, {duel:pot} {duel:points} in the pot).
join.short: @{duel:user} you don't have enough {duel:points} to stake that.
join.unknown: @{duel:user} I haven't seen you in this channel yet. Stick around to earn some {duel:points} first!
joined: @{duel:user} you're in with {duel:stake}! {duel:count} in the duel, {duel:pot} {duel:points} in the pot.
open.busy: @{duel:user} a duel is already running. Type !duel to check it.
payout_pending: @{duel:winner} takes the {duel:pot} {duel:points}. Payout is landing in a moment!
opened: Pot duel is LIVE! @{duel:user} put up {duel:stake} {duel:points}. Type !duel <amount> to join. Drawing in {duel:secs}s!
status.challenge: Duel pending: @{duel:opener} vs @{duel:target}, {duel:stake} {duel:points} each. Accept window closes in {duel:secs}s.
status.none: No duel running. Open a pot with !duel <amount>, or challenge someone with !duel <user> <amount>.
status.pot: Pot duel live: {duel:count} in, {duel:pot} {duel:points} in the pot. Drawing in ~{duel:secs}s. Type !duel <amount> to join!
won: The blades fall. @{duel:winner} defeats @{duel:loser} and takes {duel:pot} {duel:points}!
